maintenance_led.reason: Larger Construction segment (new MEP installs for hospitals, data centers, manufacturing); Owner Direct Relationships (maintenance, replacement) is the smaller part, though growing.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mostly private building owners: healthcare systems, data centers, manufacturers, universities; some public work but not the majority.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth mainly organic through MEP contracts and service expansion, with occasional acquisitions (e.g., Brandt, Pinnacle, JC Mechanical) rather than constant roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Installs and maintains HVAC, plumbing and electrical systems for hospitals and data centers; downtime and re-qualification make switching costly.

notes: Mix between new construction and maintenance/replacement is based on my background knowledge, not the website text.
